body.heading: Fold and draw
paragraphs: Your adult folds a long strip of paper like a zigzag fan.
Draw half a person on the top fold, with the hand reaching right to the edge.

body.heading: Open the chain
paragraphs: Your adult cuts around the person, carefully not cutting where the hands touch the folds.
Open it gently. A whole row of friends appears, holding hands. Colour each one differently.

takeaway: Paper friends hold hands all the way across the page, and nobody is left out.
safetyNotes: An adult does all the cutting for this activity.
screenFreeExtension: Make a paper chain of your whole family, pets included, and hang it in the kitchen.
